Keep that wording: when the head moves, re-enter with a fresh Verify that resolves evidence only from checks actually attached to the new head (or the local fallback row), claim-checks the actual readback body, and only then records P1 resolved — the course model can retain deliver authority without changing what counts as exact-head evidence.
